newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria seeks safe communications for atomic plan.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria seeks safe communications for atomic plan.

text.p: The Bulgarian Telecommunication Company (BTC) said on Friday it was negotiating with Germany's Alcatel Telekom to build a digital telecom network in the town of Kozloduy where the country's nuclear power plant stands.
The German firm has shown its readiness to invest in building the network and a digital exchange for over 20,000 phones in Kozloduy, the state news agency BTA quoted BTC officials as saying.
The final negotiations with Alcatel Telecom for supplying and installing the digital systems will be held at the beginning of October.
Some 5,000 staff of the nuclear plant live in Kozloduy and the BTC is keen to install high quality telephone lines.

"Quite often in the evenings or even at night our colleagues from the plant need to get a quick connection with us when we are not on duty and it takes them ages for them to dial a number," one Kozloduy engineer told Reuters.
